objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperlessly from creation and editing to release, distribution and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Corresponding document type selected when creating a new document.

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive, 4-digit number for each type included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title included in the document name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and is documented for released versions.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date used with the period of extended validity to calculate the valid until date.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for which a check of extended validity is necessary.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date resulting from valid from and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are retained before physical deletion.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Language version that must be released before translation can be carried out.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting detailed work steps in sub-processes.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached in the system to create new documents, additional information, attachments, requests or other objects.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to a pure object cover.

objs.name: office_document
objs.description: Document generated based on standard MS Office formats.

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: Converted format displayed on the web after a document is saved.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document automatically released with the release of the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read and change rights assigned to groups of users or persons for documents.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person using the system who may read, author, review, release, translate or acknowledge documents.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Individual assigned to document authorizations or distribution.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group assigned to documents for authorizations, reader access, distribution or archive access.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task completed by workflow participants in release and acknowledgement processes.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented for released versions.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created and managed for a document without affecting its content or version history unless scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document 30 days before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a selected document and processed by workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created for reactivation of an invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document by assigning user groups or persons for e-mail distribution or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation requested from persons or users of assigned user groups upon release of a document.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific view filled using distribution groups and listing relevant documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report available for documents in the system.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Object to which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Object to which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Object to which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Object to which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Example of master data and attribute/reference maintained via document properties.

objs.name: company
objs.description: Relevant company maintained via document properties.

objs.name: area_of_validity
objs.description: Area of validity maintained via document properties.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated or original language-dependent version of released document content.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Select the corresponding document type when creating a new document.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one or more templates defined for the selected document type when creating a new object.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_office_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: edit_document_property
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific metadata in document properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit document content using the implemented editing client.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document before system-supported conversion.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert the saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_document
evts.description: Display the current PDF version on the web.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Assign participants in the release process via property editing.

evts.name: add_additional_information
evts.description: Supplement a document with an object of the type Additional info.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Supplement a document with an object of the type Attachment.

evts.name: release_additional_information
evts.description: Release additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_information
evts.description: Publish additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: modify_additional_information
evts.description: Modify additional information without creating a new version of the associated document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment for archiving or archive it with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: initiate_approval_process
evts.description: Start the workflow-supported approval process after document creation, maintenance and control definition.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Review the document in the review step.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Complete release so the document is finally released.

evts.name: sign_workflow_task
evts.description: Complete a workflow task with an electronic signature.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the document after release so addressed readers can see it.

evts.name: create_document_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when a valid and released document is revised or certain changes occur.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document without affecting its content or version history.

evts.name: inform_author
evts.description: Inform the author of the underlying document by e-mail when a change proposal is created.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Document the editing of assigned change proposals directly in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Process a request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity so the request is deleted and the document remains valid.

evts.name: update_valid_until
evts.description: Update the valid until date by the default value of 3 years.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process when a revised document version is released.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document to invalidate it.

evts.name: process_request_for_aks
evts.description: Process the request for AKS by workflow.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declare documents and their attachments invalid and archive them.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: Revoke all authorizations except the archive group during archiving.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete documents after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: process_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Start and process the reactivation workflow automatically.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate invalidated documents.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Reactivate attachments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain distribution lists for each document by assigning user groups or persons.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform assigned users and users of assigned user groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request active acknowledgement by e-mail upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Confirm acknowledgement through a workflow-supported task without a signature.

evts.name: notify_author_team
evts.description: Notify the author team when all persons in the distribution have confirmed acknowledgement.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Fill user and role-specific dashboards using distribution groups in the distribution list.

evts.name: evaluate_document
evts.description: Evaluate documents or instructions using role-specific reports and searches.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release the translated language version with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition and reference the original document.

o2o.description: One or more document templates can be defined for each document type and selected when creating new objects.
New documents are created by attaching a new information object.
External files or documents can be uploaded to a pure object cover.
New documents can be generated based on standard MS Office formats.
Saved documents are converted to PDF and displayed on the web.
Additional information can be added to each document.
Attachments can be added to each document and are associated with the main document version.
Authorizations are assigned specifically to documents.
Users can be assigned to document roles and distribution.
Persons can be assigned to document authorizations or distribution.
User groups can be assigned to documents for readers, authorizations, distribution or archive access.
Signatures of participants are documented in the system for each released version.
A change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for AKS is created for a selected document.
A corresponding document is selected for reactivation in a request for reactivation.
Distribution lists can be maintained for each document.
Distribution is maintained by assigning user groups.
Distribution is maintained by assigning persons.
Acknowledgements relate to the current document version distributed for acknowledgement.
Dashboards list documents relevant to the user.
Reports evaluate documents stored in the system.
Documents can be automatically linked with processes.
Documents can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents can be automatically linked with risks.
Documents can be automatically linked with master data.
IT applications are given as an example of master data.
IT applications can be maintained via document properties for linking documents.
Relevant companies can be maintained via document properties.
Areas of validity can be maintained via document properties.
For each document in a multi-client system, clients in which it is visible can be specified.
Documents can have language versions shown according to login language.
Authorized readers can see the released language version in the corresponding login language.
Documents can be linked with other documents or reference original documents.

o2e.description: New document is created by attaching a new information object.
Document type is selected for the document being created.
Template is selected when creating a new object.
Pure object cover can be created for a document.
External file is uploaded to an object cover.
Office document is generated based on standard MS Office formats.
Current version is displayed on the web.
Authorization is assigned for the document.
Participants in release process are assigned through document properties.
Users are assigned as workflow participants.
Document is supplemented with additional information.
Document is supplemented with an attachment.
Modification of attachment triggers a new version of the associated main document.
Archiving of attachment is associated with the main document.
Approval process is initiated for the document.
Workflow task is completed with signature.
New editing version is created for the document.
Change proposal is created for a document.
Employees with author rights can create change proposals.
Author of the underlying document is informed.
E-mail is sent when a change proposal is created.
Change proposal is scheduled for implementation.
Scheduling creates a new document version.
Editing is documented in the change proposal.
Request for validity extension is created by the system.
Request is linked to the document to be checked.
Request is processed with workflow support.
Document remains valid in its current version.
Request for validity extension is deleted after additional validity is declared.
Release of revised version terminates the validity extension process.
Request for AKS is created for selected document.
Request for AKS is processed by workflow.
Document is declared invalid and archived.
Attachments are declared invalid and archived with the document.
Document is physically deleted after archive period expires.
Corresponding document is selected for reactivation.
Business Admin group is permitted to create requests for reactivation.
Distribution list is maintained for the document.
User groups are assigned to distribution.
New document version is distributed by e-mail notification.
Users of assigned user groups receive e-mail notification.
Recipients are requested by e-mail to acknowledge.
Acknowledgement is workflow-supported without a signature.
Notification occurs when all acknowledgements are confirmed.
Translated language version is created or maintained.
Client visibility is specified for the document.
Client is selected for document visibility.
New local document is created and references the original document.
Local document is created in a client.
